messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — incident-id=inf-2026-07-21-42. Root cause: KV-cache eviction thrash in us-west2 hosts. Impact window ~2026-07-21T15:02–17:08Z. Symptoms: elevated tail latency (5–30s) and ~2% 5xxs for hosted API. Page auto-closed.

jamal: thanks for the triage everyone. quick follow-up: we need a short postmortem, action items, and sprint prioritization. tagging folks who were on the page. @sara @mike @nora @alex :wave:

sara: agree. severity=S2 — customer-facing degradation but no data loss. we should capture customer impact numbers and which customers hit dedicated vs hosted.

mike: I can take the eviction root-fix (race in eviction scheduler). estimate ~3d dev + 1d QA. size=M. will open issues.

nora: i'll schedule the postmortem + invite the infra/product leads. proposing Thu 10am PT (calendar invite sent) — link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pm-2356789012

jamal: moving to list mode so it's clear. action items (rough):
```
- A1: KV eviction scheduler fix — owner: mike — size: M — priority: P0 — target: Q4 sprint 1
- A2: Add load/stress test in staging to reproduce eviction thrash — owner: sara — size: S — priority: P1 — target: next sprint
- A3: Service-level fallback to Dedicated when tail latency > 3s — owner: nora/product — size: L — priority: P0 — tie-in: Q4 roadmap
- A4: Add observability alert for eviction-loop anomalies + runbook update — owner: alex — size: S — priority: P1
- A5: Postmortem writeup and customer impact summary for Sales/Success — owner: jamal — size: S — priority: P1
```

alex: +1 on alerts. recommend we add an automated canary that runs long-seq workloads to catch this earlier. size:S. also will prep a dashboard tile for Console.

sara: i'll do the staging stress harness. plan: reproduce with continuous small writes + read-heavy inference; share results in #eng-ml.

mike: opening GH issues now: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/892 (evict-fix), https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/893 (unit+integration tests). assigning self.

jamal: good. for prioritization — A1 and A3 should be P0 and go into the earliest Q4 sprint. A2/A4/A5 are P1 and can be scheduled across next two sprints. we'll review at planning tomorrow.

nora: i've added labels: `post-incident`, `q4-prio`, `sev-s2` on the GH issues and backlog. will coordinate with PM to reserve sprint slot.

sara: one more: add a small CI gate that rejects regression PRs that increase eviction loop CPU by >10% — size: S.

mike: noted. also adding a temporary mitigation: reduce cache size on vulnerable hosts to lower eviction pressure (config flag) — low-risk rollbackable change. i'll push config patch and ops runbook.

jamal: thanks. owners, pls add acceptance criteria to each GH issue and include estimation in story points on the ticket. we'll use that for sprint commitment.

oncall-bot: Action items created: https://go.redwood/tasks?incident=inf-2026-07-21-42 — A1..A5 tracked. Postmortem scheduled Thu 10am PT.

jamal: wrapping up — will write the postmortem draft after the meeting, include exact customer metrics and suggested roadmap tie-ins. if anyone needs to swap owners, please speak up here by EOD. :thumbsup:
